sources.title: RFC 3161: Time-Stamp Protocol
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: RATS：證據、評估結果與政策版本的新鮮度
related.titleEn: RATS: freshness of evidence, appraisal results and policy revisions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：5與2秒可重算，錯摘要及錯nonce都失敗；重疊案例維持順序未定。 交付timestamp-pairs.csv、區間圖與關聯負例；所有文件摘要來自本地無敏感測試文字。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce five and two seconds, reject imprint and nonce mismatches, and leave ordering unresolved when the intervals overlap. Deliver timestamp-pairs.csv, interval diagrams and correlation counterexamples. All document digests derive from local nonsensitive test text, with no submission to an external timestamp service.
related.difference: 建立證據時間、評估時間、結果到期及政策修訂識別；加入有效簽章但舊政策、過期證據及錯受眾結果，分別標示哪個角色應拒絕。
related.differenceEn: Build evidence-time, appraisal-time, result-expiry and policy-revision fields. Add a valid signature under an obsolete policy, old evidence and a wrong-audience result, identifying the actor responsible for each rejection.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課兩個時間戳使用同一可信時基與已宣告精度；以最早可能完成時間減最晚可能開始時間，得到可證明的最小間隔。未宣告精度不可自行當零。 第一時間戳中心1000秒、精度±2秒，第二中心1010秒、精度±3秒；簽章、摘要與nonce先假設已通過獨立檢查。 最小分離(1010−3)−(1000+2)=5秒；第二精度擴大至±6秒時只剩2秒。
本課允許證據最長300秒，結果最長120秒；服務可用餘裕取兩項剩餘值最小者。這是本地依賴方政策，RATS架構不替所有部署指定這些秒數。 觀測時證據年齡180秒、結果年齡30秒，政策版本與受眾皆相符；保持四個時間來源可追溯而非混用本機檔案mtime。 餘裕min(300−180,120−30)=90秒；證據年齡增至260秒而結果年齡不變時，餘裕變40秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Two classroom timestamps share a trusted time base and declared accuracy. Subtract latest possible start from earliest possible finish to obtain a defensible minimum separation. Missing accuracy must not be silently interpreted as zero uncertainty. The first center is 1000 seconds with ±2-second accuracy; the second is 1010 with ±3. Signature, imprint and nonce are assumed to have passed independent checks before applying interval arithmetic. Minimum separation is (1010−3)−(1000+2)=5 seconds. Widening only the second accuracy to ±6 leaves two seconds. Subtracting centers alone would overstate the supported temporal separation.

The local policy permits evidence age up to 300 seconds and result age up to 120. Usable margin is the smaller remainder. These are relying-party choices; the RATS architecture does not mandate these durations for every deployment. At observation, evidence age is 180 seconds and result age is 30, with matching policy revision and audience. Keep the time sources traceable instead of substituting local file modification times for authenticated claims. Margin is min(300−180, 120−30)=90 seconds. Increasing evidence age to 260 while keeping result age fixed leaves 40 seconds, revealing the evidence limit as the new bottleneck.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Envoy SDS：秘密更新、確認與實際握手採用
related.titleEn: Envoy SDS: secret updates, acknowledgements and handshake adoption
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：5與2秒可重算，錯摘要及錯nonce都失敗；重疊案例維持順序未定。 交付timestamp-pairs.csv、區間圖與關聯負例；所有文件摘要來自本地無敏感測試文字。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce five and two seconds, reject imprint and nonce mismatches, and leave ordering unresolved when the intervals overlap. Deliver timestamp-pairs.csv, interval diagrams and correlation counterexamples. All document digests derive from local nonsensitive test text, with no submission to an external timestamp service.
related.difference: 建立舊新憑證公開描述、SDS版本、ACK/NACK及握手serial表；另外記錄SDS連線自身的bootstrap信任，避免用尚未取得的秘密循環建立初始信任。
related.differenceEn: Build old/new public certificate descriptors, SDS versions, ACK/NACK events and observed handshake serials. Record bootstrap trust for the SDS channel itself so initial connectivity does not depend circularly on a secret that has not yet been fetched.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課兩個時間戳使用同一可信時基與已宣告精度；以最早可能完成時間減最晚可能開始時間，得到可證明的最小間隔。未宣告精度不可自行當零。 第一時間戳中心1000秒、精度±2秒，第二中心1010秒、精度±3秒；簽章、摘要與nonce先假設已通過獨立檢查。 最小分離(1010−3)−(1000+2)=5秒；第二精度擴大至±6秒時只剩2秒。
本課剩餘輪替時間從舊憑證到期減發布後傳播及採用延遲；ACK只能是中間證據，新連線觀察到的新serial才確認本課指定的採用結果。 舊憑證將於300秒到期，100秒發布，傳播40秒、採用20秒；全部以同一事件起點計時。 餘裕300−100−40−20=140秒；傳播延長至110秒時剩70秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Two classroom timestamps share a trusted time base and declared accuracy. Subtract latest possible start from earliest possible finish to obtain a defensible minimum separation. Missing accuracy must not be silently interpreted as zero uncertainty. The first center is 1000 seconds with ±2-second accuracy; the second is 1010 with ±3. Signature, imprint and nonce are assumed to have passed independent checks before applying interval arithmetic. Minimum separation is (1010−3)−(1000+2)=5 seconds. Widening only the second accuracy to ±6 leaves two seconds. Subtracting centers alone would overstate the supported temporal separation.

The rotation margin subtracts propagation and adoption delays from old-certificate expiry. ACK is intermediate evidence; the selected acceptance test requires a new connection to observe the replacement serial, rather than relying on a control-plane event alone. The old certificate expires at second 300. Publish at 100, allow 40 seconds for propagation and 20 for adoption, all measured from one event origin. Existing long-lived connections are outside this new-handshake timing model. Margin is 300−100−40−20=140 seconds. Extending propagation to 110 seconds leaves 70. This does not claim that every existing session renegotiates when a new secret arrives.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
